designer-initial.summary: Selected and fully partitioned a small windshield-defrost request supervisor with 5 semantic usages, 13 interactions, 12 contract cases, and 5 scenario families.
questions_for_model: Can the retained model express and analyze the Request Intent Tracker pre-state/next-state contract over Released, AcceptedActive, and RearmRequired so CC-01 through CC-05 and the four-step SCN-05 recovery trace remain explicit without an untraced timer, mode, or second state owner?

Can the bounded analyzer enumerate the complete principal policy product in the declared priority order and show CC-08 through CC-11 are total and mutually consistent while retaining exactly the thirteen directed semantic interactions?

model-review.summary: Distinguish one semantic layer from physical AADL depth two; the five-owner allocation otherwise remains realizable.

findings.evidence: The baseline declares containment_depth_below_root = 1 in frontmatter, CONSTR-01, and PASS-01. Trusted Isolette uses System -> Process -> Thread containment; run 20260812T035741Z-mining-threat-retreat-hard-r1-a5 records HAMR rejecting Threads directly beneath System; and accepted run 20260813T142826Z-factory-dispatch-small-r2-a1 passed both retained type gates with one semantic responsibility layer but physical depth two through a behavior-free Process.
findings.requested_change: Change only the containment metric and matching CONSTR-01/PASS-01 claims to one semantic responsibility layer and physical depth two via exactly one behavior-free generated-support Process; relabel node_count = 5 as semantic_node_count = 5 and report six physical non-root usages including support. Preserve PART-01..PART-05, INT-01..INT-13, all 12 cases, all 5 scenarios, both outputs, state/recovery behavior, and the seed claim boundary.

findings.evidence: With the required Process shell, the unchanged 13 semantic interactions map to 21 raw PortConnection declarations: eight boundary flows require two delegations each and five inter-Thread flows require one declaration each. The extra sixteen declarations only reroute values and cannot receive semantic-interaction, owner, or usage credit.
findings.requested_change: Record the 13-to-21 semantic/raw connection mapping and tag the sixteen System/Process boundary delegations as generated support.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit finds PART-01 state-dependent fresh/held/rearm derivation; PART-02 a 4-to-3 validity classification; PART-03 a 4-to-3 eligibility classification with reason precedence; PART-04 a prioritized 5 x 3 x 3 authorization relation; and PART-05 a two-input status relation that distinguishes Inactive/None from Inactive/Blocked intents and collapses multiple fault reasons. None is a copy, bundle, reroute, or bijective enum/code rename, and INT-12 is necessary on admissible states.

Current trusted and accepted sources support local GUMBO state, initialize, In(...) pre-state access, enum functions, multi-output guarantees, and compute cases. Exhaustive analysis requires only 192 root snapshots plus owner-local products of 12, 4, 4, 45, and 25 valuations, so CC-01..CC-12 and all five multi-step scenarios are bounded and directly checkable without central owner recomputation.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved after a containment-only revision preserving the five-owner semantic design.

model-generation.summary: Canonical small-tier SysML/GUMBO source passed both retained type gates and exhaustive bounded analysis.

visualization.summary: Revalidated the retained source-bound system-overview after the operational checkpoint; native rendering, zero-crossing and zero-route-collision health gates, deterministic export, and the complete traceability audit passed.

designer-final.summary: Source-bound small-tier model matches the Designer resolution and passes bounded semantic and visualization review; execution was not run.
